phase1.name: SerialBufferPollingUtilities
phase1.role: Three entries reset software serial fields; iterate outgoing/incoming c018+index with count/index state; poll hardware SC/SB, clear SC bit0, delay3NOP, set SC bit7, wait on c028 bit1. Internal CALL129a, loop1274 and poll12ac exactly align. All exits RET. Current serial ISR does not establish a working protocol or live caller.

regions.summary: Clear serial software flags and buffer index; retain count and buffer. No ordinary caller or working serial feature is established. Return unless software flag bit0 requests processing. Transfer buffer[index] through D to the polling helper, replace it with SB, increment index and decrement count. The literal JR Z repeats only when the decremented count is zero; this is not a conventional count-down loop. Clear request bit0 on the other path. Software protocol and natural scheduling remain unproved. Reload the remaining count and index each iteration; only a zero result from DEC count loops back. Return immediately while SC bit7 is already set. Otherwise write D to SB, clear SC bit0, wait three NOPs and set SC bit7. Poll software flag bit1 until clear; this loop does not poll SC completion. A writer providing the handshake is unproved, so these instructions do not establish a functioning serial protocol. Busy-wait on software bit1. The current serial ISR is not evidence for a matching handshake writer.
